MetaboResolveR Overview

Source: vignettes/MetaboResolveR-mvp.Rmd
MetaboResolveR-mvp.Rmd

MetaboResolveR resolves post-identification untargeted human plasma metabolomics tables into evidence-scored annotation outputs. It is designed for reviewing LC-MS metabolite annotation exports, not for raw peak detection.

library(MetaboResolveR)

The main entry point is annotate_plasma_metabolites().

input <- data.frame(
  Name = c("Glucose", "Caffeine", "Unknown feature"),
  HMDB_ID = c("HMDB0000122", "HMDB0001847", "-"),
  PubChemID = c("5793", "2519", "-"),
  Score = c(0.95, 0.88, 0.50),
  check.names = FALSE
)

annotated <- annotate_plasma_metabolites(input)
annotated[, c("metabolite_name", "matched_reference_key", "final_annotation_class")]
## # A tibble: 3 × 3
##   metabolite_name matched_reference_key final_annotation_class     
##   <chr>           <chr>                 <chr>                      
## 1 Glucose         "hmdb_id"             probable_plasma_metabolite 
## 2 Caffeine        "hmdb_id"             exposure_related_metabolite
## 3 Unknown feature ""                    low_confidence_annotation

Use export_annotation_report() when you want a CSV annotation table plus a compact final-class summary.
